name: Seizure activity and onset detection
target_definition: Seizure activity intervals and onset times identified in continuous EEG recording, as annotated by expert neurophysiologists.
population: Patients with continuous EEG recordings and expert-annotated seizure events, including both with and without seizure activity.
expected_output: Seizure probability, event intervals with start and end times, and latency estimates.

reference_datasets.label: CHB-MIT EEG Database
reference_datasets.citation: Children's Hospital Boston Seizure Database, PhysioNet

limitations: Output is seizure activity detection, not an epilepsy diagnosis.
The CHB-MIT database represents pediatric seizure activity and may not generalize to adult populations.
Inter-rater agreement on seizure onset times varies; timestamps are expert-annotated but subject to observer variability.
Continuous EEG is a specialized modality not available in all clinical settings.
